Owner’s Thoughts“Living here has been all about the lifestyle. From relaxed mornings with coffee on the balcony to evenings spent walking along the Marina or meeting friends in the nearby cafés and restaurants, everything is right on the doorstep. The home works perfectly for both entertaining and quiet downtime, with flexible spaces that adapt easily to how you want to live day to day.”
What We Love
“Properties in this location are desirable and it’s easy to see why. The flexible three-bedroom layout, open-plan living, balcony and larger-than-average rear patio create a home that’s perfectly suited to modern lifestyles, all within walking distance of the Marina and city centre.”
The Rest Of The Story
Positioned in the heart of the ever-popular Hull Marina, this stylish three-bedroom townhouse offers contemporary living in one of the city’s most desirable waterfront locations. Just moments from Humber Street, the Marina and an excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants and shops, the property combines modern convenience with an enviable lifestyle.
The ground floor has been designed with modern living in mind, featuring a spacious open-plan layout that creates a sociable and welcoming atmosphere. The contemporary kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances and offers plenty of workspace, flowing effortlessly into the living and dining area. A convenient ground floor WC adds practicality, while French doors open directly onto the rear patio, creating an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply unwinding after a busy day. Larger than those found with many neighbouring townhouses, this outside space is a genuine advantage.
The first floor provides a separate main living room, offering a peaceful retreat away from the main entertaining space below. French doors lead onto a private balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee or simply enjoy some fresh air. Also on this floor is a generous double bedroom complete with fitted wardrobes, making it equally suitable as a guest bedroom or a comfortable home office.
On the top floor are two further double bedrooms, including the principal bedroom with fitted wardrobes, together with the family bathroom, creating a practical arrangement for families, professionals or those welcoming visiting guests.
The property is presented in immaculate condition throughout, with a stylish contemporary finish that allows buyers to move straight in and enjoy everything this fantastic location has to offer.
Outside, the allocated covered parking space provides valuable convenience, while the Marina itself offers a vibrant mix of waterfront walks, restaurants, cafés and leisure facilities all within easy strolling distance. Hull city centre, the mainline railway station, bus interchange and the A63 provide excellent transport connections both locally and further afield, making this an exceptional place to call home.

What Contract Ready Means for You — the Buyer
When a seller is Contract Ready, it means all the key legal documents are prepared before a sale is agreed, so everything’s ready to go as soon as the offer is accepted, with no cost to you. 
This includes:
• Proof of ownership and authority to sell• Seller’s Property Information Forms (TA6, TA10)• Draft contract of sale
Your solicitor usually receives the full legal pack within 48 hours, so they can get to work immediately.
How this helps you:• Reduces the number of enquiries going back and forth• Smoother and potentially quicker sale • Lowers the risk of the sale falling through
